purpose: Renders Markdown source as formatted content, synchronously by default, with opt-in lazy math, code blocks, scrolling tables, and optional link and image policies.
useWhen: Showing Markdown that a person or a model wrote, such as a message, an instruction or an artifact.
Rendering Markdown that grows as it streams, without the raw source flashing between updates (set `math`).
Showing Markdown with equations: set `math`; without it, dollar signs such as "$25–$100" stay literal.

avoidWhen.reason: Editing Markdown — use the markdown editor in the editor package.
Showing a single snippet of source code — use code-block.

rationale: Nearest alternative: an `{@html}` of the rendered output — that shows no code block controls or table scroller, loads the renderer synchronously, and cannot keep a streamed render on screen while the next one lands.
